candidate_relations.reason: The clinical and histopathologic findings—cornoid lamellae, parakeratosis, atrophy of epidermis, decreased granular layer, individual cell dyskeratosis, and vacuolar basal degeneration—are pathognomonic for porokeratosis, not sarcoidosis. Sarcoidosis would show non-caseating granulomas on biopsy, which are absent here. The rapid eruptive pruritic course with annular keratotic papules on extremities further supports EPPP over sarcoidosis.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Sarcoidosis is a granulomatous systemic disease; the reference diagnosis is eruptive pruritic papular porokeratosis (EPPP), a keratinization disorder defined by cornoid lamellae on histology

case_quality_flags: Histopathology is highly specific for porokeratosis (cornoid lamellae); no diagnostic ambiguity in the record
